about.heroPhotoAlt: The skinlab. team at a professional demonstration – cosmetic laser and beauty equipment
about.storySection1: It all started with a cosmetic treatment abroad. Szimonetta was travelling when she noticed that salons in Western Europe worked with machines on a completely different level than at home: more professional, more precise, more modern devices that Hungarian beauticians could only dream of at the time. On the way home one thought kept going round in her head: why couldn’t these machines be brought to Hungary too?
about.storySection2a: Szimonetta comes from a family of healthcare professionals; she was practically born into a mindset where precision, responsibility and respect for how the human body works are core values. She also studied at Semmelweis University, yet it soon became clear to her that she truly belonged in the beauty industry. She worked in permanent make-up too, but her real passion turned out to be laser technology.
about.storySection2b: László, on the other hand, is technically minded, a great lover of cars and technical solutions. So the perfect recipe was there: Szimonetta’s beauty-industry experience and László’s technical approach together laid the foundations of {companyName}.
about.storySection3Title: It all started with tattoo removal
about.storySection3: Their first shared love was the YAG laser. By great fortune they learned the fundamentals of this technology from a world-renowned Russian doctor (laser treatments have a serious tradition in Russia). From then on the goal was not only to import premium cosmetic lasers, but also to bring the related expertise to Hungary – together with the professional mindset that can lift a salon to international standards.
about.storySection4a: {companyName} started as a business but became a passion. It turned out that there is huge demand for exceptional-quality, AI-assisted laser cosmetic devices in Hungary too.
about.storySection4b: Ever since, Szimonetta and László have travelled the world regularly, from Russia to America, to learn the latest knowledge and procedures first-hand from the best. The guiding principle of {companyName} is to always pass on the most modern, safest and most effective techniques to our partners.
about.storySection5a: At skinlab. we don’t simply sell machines. We choose every device only after long testing, because we only pass on machines that we know, love and can wholeheartedly recommend ourselves.
about.storySection5b: An in-house service centre is a rarity in Hungary, but it lets us make sure every machine we sell can be repaired quickly and safely – because we know these are income-generating tools.
about.storySection5c: We believe in straightforward, clear communication, because for us trust and relationships are just as important as the technology itself.
about.storySection5d: And perhaps most importantly: we don’t let go of your hand or leave you on your own after the purchase. For us, follow-up means helping with use, settings and questions – and being there when you are already working with your machine in your own salon.

page.metaDescription: Professional cosmetic device operator training with a professional and medical background. Certificate registered in FAR, the Hungarian adult education registry (B number). No obligation to buy a device.
page.heroTitle: Training – Professional cosmetic and aesthetic device operator courses
page.heroLead: Professional cosmetic device operator training with a professional and medical background
page.whyLead: We created our courses for those who want to master cosmetic and aesthetic devices not just superficially, but with real, professionally grounded knowledge.
page.pillar1Desc: Our courses are built on a genuine medical foundation and background.
page.pillar2Desc: We work with clinically proven results and established protocols.
page.pillar3Desc: We place great emphasis on safe, responsible and professional treatments.
page.deepAlt: Hands-on device training on a live model under instructor supervision
page.deepP1: With us you will not get a rushed, one-hour "plug-and-go" session. Instead of just showing you how to switch on your device, we pass on deep, comprehensive and practice-oriented knowledge.
page.deepP2: We teach you to operate the device correctly, set the parameters with confidence and recognise risk factors, and we prepare you for every possible situation – positive and negative – you may encounter during client treatments.
page.legalP1: Our courses also cover the legal side: we go through the legal framework of device use, the mandatory elements of client information, documentation requirements and the protocols that support professional responsibility and safety.
page.legalP2: Every course also includes a marketing and business module to help you build your services with confidence, set your prices, communicate, and create a business that is sustainable in the long term.
page.legalAlt: Treatment manual and certificate at the end of the device operator course
page.noBuyAlt: Hands-on treatment under instructor supervision during the course
page.noBuyTitle: No obligation to buy a device
page.noBuyP1: Our courses are available without buying a device, and we put no pressure on you regarding any later equipment purchase.
page.noBuyP2: Our goal is not to sell you a device but to pass on real, practical knowledge and support your professional development – regardless of whether you buy your equipment from us or from another distributor.
page.certP1: All our courses run within an official framework and are registered in FAR, the Hungarian Adult Education Data Registration System. After successfully completing a course, we issue a B-numbered certificate that confirms your professional competence and your ability to apply the technologies you have learned correctly.
page.certAlt: Graduate with her certificate after the THE FROST cold plasma course

withdrawal.metaDescription: 14-day right of withdrawal without giving reasons under Hungarian Government Decree 45/2014 (II.26.). Conditions, procedure and refunds at Skinlab.
withdrawal.heroLead: As a consumer, you can withdraw from your purchase within 14 days of receipt without giving any reason. Below we summarise the conditions and the exact procedure.
withdrawal.introText: Under Hungarian Government Decree 45/2014 (II.26.) (45/2014. (II.26.) Korm. rendelet), as a consumer you are entitled to withdraw from the contract without giving any reason within 14 days of receiving the product. The withdrawal period starts on the day you receive the product.
withdrawal.step1Title: Tell us you wish to withdraw
withdrawal.step1Text: In writing (by e-mail) or by phone, within 14 days of receipt. A clear statement of your intention is enough – no reason is required.
withdrawal.step2Text: Undamaged, complete and in its original packaging, to the agreed address. We will help you arrange the return.
withdrawal.step3Text: We refund the purchase price of the product within 14 days of receiving your notice of withdrawal.
withdrawal.condition1: The product must be returned undamaged, complete and in its original packaging.
withdrawal.condition2: The direct cost of returning the product is borne by the buyer – unless the product is returned because of defective performance.
withdrawal.condition3: We refund the purchase price within 14 days of receiving your notice of withdrawal.
withdrawal.exclusionsTitle: When does the right of withdrawal not apply?
withdrawal.exclusion1: Devices that have been unsealed, used or put into operation
withdrawal.exclusion2: Products that cannot be returned for hygiene reasons (e.g. handpieces, applicators, treatment products once opened)
withdrawal.exclusion3: Products sourced or ordered to individual specifications
withdrawal.footnote: The right of withdrawal applies to consumers. For business (company) purchases, the withdrawal conditions are set out in the detailed Terms and Conditions. You can read about warranty claims on the Warranty page.
withdrawal.formText: Download or print the official model withdrawal/cancellation form (Government Decree 45/2014), fill it in and send it back to us by e-mail or post.
withdrawal.ctaText: We are here to help – write to us or call us and we will go through the details.

warranty.whatIsWarrantyDesc1: A warranty is a binding commitment by the manufacturer and distributor that the device will operate without failure under intended use during the warranty period. In case of manufacturing or material defects, repair, part replacement and - where justified - replacement and labor are free of charge.
warranty.whatIsWarrantyDesc2: We provide 24 months of warranty on new cosmetic devices and 12 months on tattoo and PMU machines (the exact duration is also on the product sheet), in line with Hungarian government decrees 151/2003. (IX. 22.) and 19/2014. (IV. 29.) NGM.
warranty.commitmentDesc1: Our own trained Hungarian technician team and workshop ensures that you do not have to wait months for foreign repair in case of a fault. We work with original factory parts and, for repairs exceeding 10 business days, provide a replacement device subject to availability, so your business keeps running.
warranty.commitmentDesc2: We stay by your side after the purchase as well: remote diagnostics, phone support and - if necessary - on-site visits keep your operation running continuously.
warranty.contentDesc: The manufacturer warranty includes the following cases, provided the fault occurred during normal use and with the user manual followed:
warranty.point1: Full repair of manufacturing and material defects.
warranty.point2: Replacement of original factory parts, including labor costs, free of charge.
warranty.point3: Replacement device program - for repairs exceeding 10 business days we provide a loaner device for the duration of the repair, subject to availability.
warranty.point4: Remote diagnostics and expert phone support for troubleshooting.
warranty.point5: On-site service visit where needed, by individual agreement.
warranty.exclusionsSubtitle: The warranty does not extend to the following cases:
warranty.exclusion1: Damage from misuse, negligence or careless handling.
warranty.exclusion2: Unauthorized modification, opening of the device or repair attempts by non-official service providers.
warranty.exclusion3: Damage from external events (drop, liquid damage, overvoltage, lightning strike).
warranty.exclusion4: Connection to improper electrical grid, missing stabilizer or grounding.
warranty.exclusion5: Normal wear of consumable parts (see below).
warranty.consumable2: Outer cover of handpieces and applicators
warranty.consumable6: External damage to cables and accessories
warranty.consumablesNote: The lifetime of consumables depends on usage intensity. We supply replacements continuously at favorable prices.
warranty.claimSubtitle: Report faults via the following channels:
warranty.claimInfoTitle: What to include in your report?
warranty.claimInfo1: Device type, serial number and date of purchase.
warranty.claimInfo2: Detailed description of the fault, if possible with photo or video.
warranty.claimInfo3: Invoice or warranty card received at purchase.
warranty.claimInfo4: Name and contact details of the point-of-contact person.
warranty.importantNote: Do not attempt to repair or disassemble the device yourself - unauthorized intervention voids the warranty. When you notice a fault, disconnect the machine and contact us.
warranty.ctaSubtitle: Our expert team is happy to help - call us or send an email.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Skinlab equipment, training, warranty and shipping.
faq.ctaSubtitle: Our team is happy to help with any specific question. Reach us by phone or message.

orderShipping.q1: How long does it take for the ordered machine to arrive?
orderShipping.a1: Professional cosmetic and aesthetic devices are made to order, so the typical delivery time is 15–25 working days. For custom colours or configurations this can even double. Accessories and supplies kept in stock ship within 1–4 working days.
orderShipping.q2: How does the machine arrive in the country?
orderShipping.a2: Every machine enters Hungary through DHL's official contracted channel with full customs clearance, authentic documentation and end-to-end tracking. We do not use dubious DDP workarounds - the process is legal, transparent and secure.
orderShipping.q3: What payment methods can I choose from?
orderShipping.a3: For custom-order machines, 50% of the total price is due as a deposit at the time of order, and the remaining 50% is payable on arrival, before handover. For discounted products the full amount is required upfront. Accepted methods: SimplePay card payment, bank transfer, and in our showroom cash or POS terminal payment.
orderShipping.q4: Where can I pick up the machine?
orderShipping.a4: Pickup can be arranged in person at our showroom ({showroom}), where we walk you through installation, training and documentation - free of charge, by prior appointment. If in-person pickup isn't possible, our contracted courier service handles delivery with individually quoted rates.

warrantyService.q1: What warranty comes with the machines?
warrantyService.a1: New cosmetic and medical aesthetic devices sold in our webshop come with a 12–24 month warranty (the exact duration is shown on each product page). The warranty covers manufacturing defects and failures during proper use. We follow Hungarian Government Decree 151/2003 (IX. 22.) and NGM Decree 19/2014 (IV. 29.).
warrantyService.q2: How long does a repair take?
warrantyService.a2: Turnaround for minor faults is 3–7 working days; for larger part replacements it's 10–20 working days. The precise time is confirmed after inspection. Repairs are carried out by our in-house trained technicians using original parts.
warrantyService.q3: Do I get a replacement machine during repair?
warrantyService.a3: If the preliminary assessment shows the repair is likely to take more than 10 business days, we provide a loaner device for the duration of the repair, subject to availability - free of charge under warranty, or on preferential terms outside of warranty. The loaner may not be the exact same model, but it is suitable for continuing treatments.
warrantyService.q4: What should I do if the machine shows an error or doesn't turn on?
warrantyService.a4: First, switch it off, disconnect power, let it cool and restart. If the fault persists, reach us at {phone} or {email} - remote diagnostics solve most issues.

training.q1: Do I get an official certificate after the training?
training.a1: Yes. All our training is registered in the Hungarian Adult Education Record System (FAR) and concludes with a B-number certificate. The certificate verifies your professional competence and your ability to apply the taught technologies safely and correctly.
training.q2: Do I have to buy a machine from you to attend the training?
training.a2: No. Our training is available without any purchase obligation, and we don't pressure attendees into a later equipment purchase. Our goal is real, practical knowledge - regardless of whether you buy equipment from us or another distributor.
training.q3: What do the training sessions cover?
training.a3: Our training is built on a healthcare background and clinically proven technology. We cover in-depth theory and practice: parameter settings, treatment protocols, risk factors, legal and documentation requirements, plus marketing and business modules.
training.q4: Does training come with the purchased machine?
training.a4: Yes. At handover or at a separately agreed time we provide theoretical training, treatment protocols, and detailed usage and maintenance guides - so you can start working with confidence from day one.

products.q1: Do I need an official permit to use a diode laser?
products.a1: For cosmetic use no government permit is required, but professional training and certification are strongly recommended for safe operation. Every machine we sell comes with safety documentation and CE certification, and our training equips you with all necessary knowledge.
products.q2: Which skin types are diode lasers suitable for?
products.a2: Multi-wavelength diode lasers (e.g. 755/808/1064 nm) are safe on most skin types year-round. For certain ND:YAG treatments there may be seasonal recommendations - these are always decided individually based on professional protocol.
products.q3: What is the lifespan of a laser handpiece?
products.a3: The lifetime of diode laser handpieces varies by machine: OLYMPIA, for example, is guaranteed to deliver full power for up to 100 million shots. For ND:YAG lasers the handpiece lifetime is 1.2–1.8 million shots. Lifetime depends on the energy settings and the cooling used. Handpieces are replaceable, and our service team installs original or compatible replacement heads.
products.q4: How safe are the machines you sell?
products.a4: Every machine has CE certification, authentic documentation and passed safety testing. With proper training and regular maintenance (6–12 month inspection recommended), operation is safe and reliable over the long term.

general.a1: Skinlab Beauty Equipment Kft. is the official distributor of professional cosmetic and medical aesthetic equipment in Hungary. We support our partners with authentic documentation, in-house service, 12–24 month warranty and FAR-registered training.
general.q2: How can I get in touch with you?
general.a2: You can reach us by phone at {phone} or by email at {email}. Our customer service is available Monday to Friday 10:00–18:00 and Saturday 10:00–14:00. You can also send us a message through our website form.
general.q3: Can I see the machines in person?
general.a3: Of course - the showroom ({showroom}) is open free of charge by appointment. You can try the devices live, get personalized advice from our experts and even discuss installation on the spot.

foundersHome.title: Where two worlds meet - this is who we are
foundersHome.intro: The two of us founded Skinlab: Szimonetta came from the beauty industry with a healthcare background, László from the world of technology and machines. A treatment abroad set us on our way: we saw the level of devices they work with in the West, and we decided to bring this quality - and the know-how behind it - to Hungarian salons too.
foundersHome.quote: We don't want to sell machines; we want to provide usable expertise, safety and human support. We only sell devices that we know ourselves, like and recommend wholeheartedly - and we don't let go of our partners' hands after the purchase either.
